subject: Audit & Inspection Exhibit — evidence gating and pen-test window negotiation
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@crestwellhealth.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Audit & Inspection Exhibit — evidence gating and pen-test window negotiation

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for taking time today. Per our conversation, I'm sending a concise proposal for how Redwood can handle the inspection / audit language in the MSA + Order Form to keep Crestwell comfortable while minimizing operational burden on both sides. High level:

- We can accept bounded inspection rights (sampled, scoped by SOC 2 assertions) rather than full live forensic access.
- Pen-test coordination: propose a 30-day notice window, with a mutually agreed 3-day staging window and a single 72-hour live test window. We will provide a list of required IP ranges and an ops contact.
- Evidence cadence: weekly ticket-based delivery of SOC 2 artifacts and a quarterly snapshot export for logs (S3 link) + a single annual SOC 2 attestation.

Attached: a marked Order Form (crestwell_orderform_comments.pdf) with the specific language we discussed + a draft pen-test-scope-proposal.xlsx that shows the suggested windows.

Could you confirm whether Crestwell needs privileged remote inspection (i.e., admin-level console access) or if sampled evidence + log exports satisfy audit requirements for your compliance team? If you do need privileged inspection, we can scope a controlled, time-boxed session with NDA and RBAC controls (we'll need to level-set who has the credentials and the on-call contact).

If it helps, Vanessa (cc'd) will be our operational point for pen-test logistics and Laura will coordinate the contractual markups.

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm inspection preference (privileged vs sampled) by Wed 7/14
2) If privileged, we set a short call to scope the session (ops + security)
3) We produce a revised redline to the MSA and Order Form by 7/16

Thanks,

Jordan Blake
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: crestwell_orderform_comments.pdf (PDF, annotated), pen-test-scope-proposal.xlsx (Excel)

From: Elena Martinez <elena@crestwellhealth.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Crestwell Health Procurement <procurement@crestwellhealth.com>, contracts@crestwellhealth.com
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit & Inspection Exhibit — evidence gating and pen-test window negotiation

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear summary and the attachments. Quick answers from our side after an initial intake with compliance:

- Privileged remote inspection: not preferred. Our policy allows sampled evidence + secured log exports for SaaS vendors, provided the evidence map covers the SOC 2 in-scope systems.
- Pen-test: the 30-day notice + staging and 72-hour window sounds reasonable. Procurement will want the SLA/cutover fallback spelled out if a pen-test causes an incident.
- Evidence cadence: procurement wants bi-weekly access to any requested artifact while an audit is open (not just weekly). Can you do bi-weekly for active audits and weekly for routine evidence requests?

I'll attach our annotated MSA page with the clauses we consider non-negotiable (redlines attached). Also adding two names from compliance for the ops call: 
- Marco Ruiz (marco.ruiz@crestwellhealth.com) — InfoSec lead
- Priya Shah (priya.shah@crestwellhealth.com) — Compliance manager

We'd like to get legal alignment this week. If Redwood can accept sampled inspections + bi-weekly evidence cadence during open audits, we can push the contract internally.

—Elena

Attachments: crestwell_msa_required_clauses.pdf (PDF, highlighted)

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@crestwellhealth.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 08:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit & Inspection Exhibit — evidence gating and pen-test window negotiation

Elena / Jordan —

Great to see alignment on sampled evidence and the pen-test windows. Operational clarifications from our side: 

- Bi-weekly during active audits: we can accommodate bi-weekly artifact drops into a secured Drive folder while an audit is open (we'll stream a short manifest via a ticketing system each delivery). For routine requests we will keep weekly cadence.
- Privileged access: we will not provide admin console credentials. If Crestwell's auditors require deeper access we propose a time-boxed, recorded session in our staging environment with scoped accounts; this will be a billable professional services item.
- Incident fallback: for any pen-test that materially affects service availability we will trigger our incident runbook and maintain an SLA escalation (we will share an excerpt during the legal review).

Karthik — flagged a few non-standard contract asks in Elena's attachment that I think legal will want to push back on (broad indemnity language, open-ended forensic access). Laura, can you prepare a compact redline that: 1) allows sampled evidence + staged sessions, 2) replaces broad forensic access with defined inspection steps, 3) clarifies notice and remediation timelines for pen-tests?

Elena — I'm happy to schedule the ops + compliance call for Friday 7/16 at 11am PT if that works. That call will include Marco and Priya from Crestwell and Karthik + one engineer from our security team.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Head of Customer Operations | Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2-summary-2027.pdf (PDF, summary), pen-test-scope-proposal.xlsx (updated)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Elena Martinez <elena@crestwellhealth.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2027 14:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Audit & Inspection Exhibit — evidence gating and pen-test window negotiation

Team / Elena —

Attaching a focused MSA redline (redwood_msa_marked_v2.docx) which:
- Replaces blanket inspection language with a three-step exhibit: evidence map -> sampled artifacts -> time-boxed staging session (if necessary).
- Limits notice for pen-tests to 30 days, allows emergency exception with written approval from Redwood security, and defines a single remediation window (30 days) for any findings that materially affect PII handling.
- Adds a clause for professional services billing if privileged or extended inspection is requested.

We kept the language short and prescriptive to reduce back-and-forth. If Crestwell is comfortable with sampled evidence + the staging session option, we are ready to move the MSA redline and final Order Form into DocuSign.

Next steps:
- Elena / Crestwell procurement: confirm acceptance of the three-step exhibit by end of day Monday 7/19
- If accepted, Laura will prepare the final Order Form with the agreed SLA and the pen-test annex and route for signature

Laura — I've highlighted three clauses that legal should watch for pushback (Sections 5.2, 7.4, and the new Exhibit D).

Karthik Iyer
Senior Counsel, Contracts & Security
Redwood Inference

Attachments: redwood_msa_marked_v2.docx (Word, tracked changes)
